_comments._about: Copy this file to apply/user/profile.json and fill it in. Factual fields only. The agent types these values into ATS forms. Leave any field empty to have the agent skip it and list it as pending.
_comments.name: Full name as it appears on your resume. Greenhouse splits it on the last space into first and last name.
_comments.phone: Phone number with country code, for example +1 555 555 5555.
_comments.location: Current city and state or country, for example Boston, MA. Used for location typeahead fields.
_comments.address: Both shapes of your address. Greenhouse usually wants the single line. Lever and Ashby often want the structured parts.
_comments.address.single_line: One-line mailing address, for example 123 Main St, Boston, MA 02110.
_comments.address.structured: The same address split into street, city, state, and zip. Fill every part.
_comments.school: Current or most recent school, exactly as ATS school dropdowns list it.
_comments.degree: Degree type, for example Bachelor of Science.
_comments.major: Field of study, for example Computer Science.
_comments.grade_level: Current year, for example Junior or Rising Senior.
_comments.gpa: GPA as a string, for example 3.8. Leave empty to never volunteer it.
_comments.grad_date: Expected graduation, for example May 2028. ATS forms usually want month and year.
_comments.work_authorization: Answer to 'Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?'. Use Yes or No.
_comments.requires_sponsorship: Legacy single sponsorship answer. Prefer the two scoped fields below. Used as a fallback when a scoped field is empty.
_comments.requires_sponsorship_now: Answer to current-role sponsorship questions, for example 'Do you require sponsorship for this role?'. Use Yes or No. An F-1 student on CPT often answers No here.
_comments.requires_sponsorship_future: Answer to 'Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?'. Use Yes or No. An F-1 student on CPT often answers Yes here. Forms phrase sponsorship both ways, which is why this is two fields.
_comments.willing_to_relocate: Answer to 'Are you willing to relocate?'. Use Yes or No.
_comments.willing_onsite: Answer to onsite or in-office questions. Use Yes or No.
_comments.willing_travel_pct: Maximum travel you accept, as a percent string, for example 25. The agent answers Yes to 'willing to travel N%' when N is at or below this, otherwise leaves it pending.
_comments.start_availability: When you can start, for example May 2027 or Immediately.
_comments.desired_compensation: Salary or hourly expectation as you want it typed, for example 45/hr or 110000. Leave empty to never volunteer it.
_comments.drivers_license: Answer to 'Do you have a valid driver's license?'. Use Yes or No.
_comments.veteran_status: EEO field. Optional. Use the canonical value 'decline' to pick the decline option, translated per ATS by the fieldmaps, or the exact answer you want.
_comments.disability_status: EEO field. Optional. Use 'decline' or the exact answer you want.
_comments.gender: EEO field. Optional. Use 'decline' or the exact answer you want.
_comments.race_ethnicity: EEO field. Optional. Use 'decline' or the exact answer you want.
_comments._eeo: Store one canonical EEO answer here. The fieldmaps translate 'decline' into each ATS's wording: 'Decline to self-identify' on Greenhouse, 'I do not wish to answer' on Lever, 'Prefer not to say' on Ashby.
_comments.custom: Free key/value map for anything else the agent may answer from, for example clearance level or spoken languages. Keys are your own labels. The agent only uses these when a screener clearly asks for one.
